$comment: Source of truth for every external asset. `npm run assets -- --fetch` downloads sources into /assets-src; `npm run assets` converts them into /public/assets and regenerates src/assets/manifest.json (runtime index) and CREDITS.md. Entries whose source is missing fall back to a procedural stand-in with the same id at runtime and are listed in ASSETS_TODO.md.
